summary.name: Socialmon
summary.one_liner: Socialmon is an AI-powered search and inspiration library of high-performing marketing posts from social media, email, ads and landing pages, organized into shared boards, and not yet launched (launch stated as November 2026).
use_cases: Find proven social posts for a specific niche
Build shared inspiration boards for campaigns
Collect reference posts for designers and copywriters
Save social posts with captions from Instagram and LinkedIn
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Socialmon as a user-driven, AI-powered discovery engine for viral marketing content, where you describe a niche or topic and get high-performing posts for inspiration. Currently it saves static posts (carousels, images, PDFs) from Instagram and LinkedIn, with ads, email campaigns, SEM landing pages and short-form video listed as coming soon. Saved items keep the full post, including captions and copy, and can be filtered by content type and growth goal such as follower growth, engagement, clicks or conversions. Users can organize saved items into visual boards shared with team members, and save content via a Chrome extension.
notable: Saves the complete post including captions and copy, not just visuals
AI-tagged search and filters by growth goal and content type
caveats: Not yet launched; page says launch is November 2026 and users join a waitlist or pre-order
Free plan limited to 30 post views per month and 1 board; advanced filters and team collaboration require the Pro plan
Currently only static posts from Instagram and LinkedIn; ads, emails, landing pages and videos are coming soon
